text:
Lina: Quick heads-up — we're entering a code-lock for the RC stamp in ~2h. Please avoid merging to main unless it's already approved and green.
Paul: Got it. I have a deps PR (PR: #5234) that updates an internal protobuf. Is that considered urgent?
Lina: If it touches runtime compatibility or changelog surface, we should gate it. Can you summarize the risk in one line here?
Paul: It's a minor proto field reorder for telemetry v2. No schema break expected, but it changes the serialization order for a couple of services.
Mike: @Paul if it's serialization-related we should do a canary deploy first. If you need an exception, add label `release/exception` and paste the rollout plan here.
Paul: Adding label now. Plan: canary on staging -> smoke for 1h -> promote. Cherry-pick is small.
Sara: Also reminder to add a changelog entry under "Telemetry". Docs owners will need that for release notes.
devops-bot: Automated reminder: RC stamp in 90 minutes. See https://redwood.internal/release-process for exception steps.
Julie: Small request — branch `perf-bench` still needs untangling. If anyone is actively rebase-ing, call it out here so we don't get merge conflicts during stamping.
Mike: I'm rebasing `perf-bench` now, ETA ~25m. Will stop at the code-lock cutoff.
Lina: Thanks. Few procedural notes: 1) Label `release/exception` + short reason + rollback strategy required. 2) Exceptions reviewed by oncall + release lead. 3) If approved, ops will do the merge during stamp.
Paul: Ok I posted the exception rationale and rollback steps. @Mike can you do the canary once it's merged to staging?
Mike: Yep. Ping me in #staging when it's up.
Sara: For changelog: paste a one-liner here and I'll prod docs to include it.
Paul: Changelog: "Telemetry: update proto ordering to support v2 metrics (no behavioral change expected)."
Lina: Perfect. One last ask — if you merge an exception, add a short deploy note like `merged-by: <name>, reason: X, rollback: Y` in the PR description. Makes audits easier.
Paul: Will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
